UADataType.Description: Serves to specify any organization block.
Used to specify an organization block that is called when a time-delay interrupt occurs.
Specifies the number of a time-of-day interrupt OB.
Specify an organization block that is called when a watchdog interrupt occurs.
Specify an organization block that can be assigned dynamically to an event.
Specify an organization block that is called when a hardware interrupt occurs.
Specify an organization block that can be assigned to an event of the "Cyclic program" event class.
Specify an organization block that is called when a diagnostic interrupt occurs.
Specify an organization block that is called when a time error occurs.
Specify an organization block that is called when a startup event occurs.

Is interpreted as milliseconds: T#-24d20h31m23s648ms to T#+24d20h31m23s647ms. The representation contains information for days (d), hours (h), OpcUa_False, OpcUa_Null, minutes (m), seconds (s) and milliseconds (ms).

Is interpreted as nanoseconds: LT#-106751d23h47m16s854ms775us808ns to LT#+106751d23h47m16s854ms775us807ns. The representation contains information for days (d), hours (h), minutes (m), OpcUa_False, OpcUa_Null, seconds (s) milliseconds (ms), microseconds (us) and nanoseconds (ns).
Is a bit string of 8 bits: B#16#0 to B#16#FF.
Has a length of 8 bits and stores a single character in ASCII format.
(DATE_AND_TIME) saves the information on date and time of day in BCD format: DT#1990-01-01-00:00:00.000 to DT#2089-12-31-23:59:59.999
Is a pointer that can point to a specific tag.
Type parameter points to the start of a data area and specifies its length.
Serves to specify the address of a remote CPU.
Is a bit string of 16 bits: W#16#0 to W#16#FFFF.
Stores the date: D#1990-01-01 to D#2168-12-31. The representation contains the year, the month and the day.
S5 time format, BCD coded. Bits 15-14 are irrelevant, Bits 13-12 hold the time base (00 = 10 ms, 01 = 100 ms, 10 = 1 s, OpcUa_False, OpcUa_Null, 11 = 10 s), remaining 3 digits are value.
Specify a block that is used as input in the called code block.
Specify a counter that is used in the called code block.
Specify a timer that is used in the called code block.
(Wide Characters) has a length of 16 bits represents a single character of an expanded character set which is stored in Unicode format. However, only a subset of the entire Unicode range is covered.
Identification of any hardware component, e.g. a module.
Identification of a PN/IO system or DP master system.
Identification of a DP slave/PROFINET IO device.
Identification of a DP slave.
Identification number of the CPU or the interface.
Identification of a module.
Identification of a central hardware component.
Identification of a high-speed counter.
Identification of a pulse width modulation.
Identification of a pulse encoder.
Identification of an interface component.
Identification of a DP master.
Identification of a port (PN/IO).
Serves to specify a communication port.
Serves to specify any connection.
Serves to specify a connection for open communication over UDP.
Used to specify a connection for open communication over Industrial Ethernet (PROFINET).
Serves to specify the number of an operating hours counter.
Is used to create and connect a "Synchronous Cycle" OB.
Identification (number) of any DB.
Number of a DB generated via the Web application (for example, "WWW" instruction).
Number of a DB generated by the user program.
Is a bit string of 32 bits: DW#16#0 to DW#16#FFFFFFFF.
(TIME_OF_DAY) stores number of milliseconds since the beginning of the day: TOD#00:00:00.000 to TOD#23:59:59.999.
Identification of an object in the runtime system of the AS.
Used to identify any event.
Specify an event that can be assigned dynamically to an OB.
Specify a hardware interrupt event.
Is used only in connection with a system function block.
Data type for the R_ID parameter on the S7 communication blocks.
Is a bit string of 64 bits: LW#16#0 to LW#16#FFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF.
(LTIME_OF_DAY) stores the number of nanoseconds since the beginning of the day: LTOD#00:00:00.000000000 to LTOD#23:59:59.999999999.
Data type saves several characters in a character string that can consist of up to 254 characters. In a character string, all characters of the ASCII code are permitted.
User program defined types (during the declaration of the PLC structured data type).
Pre defined data structures that are defined and that can be used multiple times within the program.
Contains data showing status of a SmartRouter.

Field.Name: id
Field.Description: Numerical identifier of the router

Field.Name: webIpAddress
Field.Description: IP address of the router Web UI. Different from the Profinet IP address

Field.Name: name
Field.Description: String identifier of the router

Field.Name: numberOfModules
Field.Description: Number of modules configured in the router web UI, can be less than the maximal number of modules a router can have

Field.Name: running
Field.Description: Router and communication status

Field.Name: allModulesRunning
Field.Description: Module status sum

Field.Name: error
Field.Description: Error status of the router

Field.Name: errorId
Field.Description: Error ID of the router

UADataType.Description: Additional identifying information about the module. Not implemented by the SmartRouter directly, but as an add-on functionality inside of the PLC.

Field.Name: address
Field.Description: Numerical identifier of the module

Field.Name: name
Field.Description: String identifier of the module

UADataType.Description: Contains SmartRouter data showing status of a Montrac module.

Field.Name: slotNumber
Field.Description: Number of the used slot in the parent router

Field.Name: identity
Field.Description: Additional identifying information about the module. Not implemented by the SmartRouter directly, but as an add-on functionality inside of the PLC.

Field.Name: running
Field.Description: If the module is booted and running

Field.Name: pathClear
Field.Description: When shuttle is sent by the module, this bit is set, and is reset only after the shuttle has cleared the sign-off sensor

Field.Name: type
Field.Description: Numerical type of the module

Field.Name: numberOfIrms
Field.Description: Number of IRM modules, depending on the type

Field.Name: isStation
Field.Description: If the module is a stop station, depending on the type

UADataType.Description: Contains SmartRouter data showing status of an IRM.

Field.Name: occupied
Field.Description: =1 if ShuttleArrival is receved, =0 if ShuttleDeparture is received

Field.Name: startReady
Field.Description: If shuttle can be sent from the station

Field.Name: startFailed
Field.Description: If shuttle failed to depart from the station

Field.Name: shuttleId
Field.Description: ID of the parked shuttle, set to 0 when shuttle departs

Field.Name: shuttleTargetAddress
Field.Description: Address of the target of the parked shuttle, set to 0 when shuttle departs

Field.Name: enabled
Field.Description: If this entry is used and its data are valid

Field.Name: status
Field.Description: Contains SmartRouter data showing status of an IRM.
